what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Mozambique in Zimbabwe: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 6736 Mozambican asylum seekers in Zimbabwe, 93.5% of all asylum seekers from Mozambique.
Zimbabwe hosts almost all asylum seekers from Mozambique.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Mozambique in every year from 2019 to 2025.
It also records armed conflict over the government of Mozambique in periods from 2013 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2016 at 656 asylum seekers, and the figure was at its highest, 8455, at the end of 2024.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2017 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Zimbabwe.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Zimbabwe only.
